inspiration.observed_pattern: A multi-join revenue report groups by two dimensions with WITH ROLLUP and uses GROUPING() inside CASE expressions to label detail, subtotal, and grand-total rows.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a catalog revenue matrix. Orders join line items, products, and categories; COUNT(DISTINCT) counts orders, ROUND computes revenue, and MariaDB-compatible NULL checks in CASE label category and status rollup levels because the grouped dimensions are NOT NULL. The source schema, identifiers, values, and application context are not copied.

fixture_notes: Two categories and two order states create detail rows, category subtotals, and one grand total. Order 9001 has two line items so COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) differs from line count; revenue uses quantity times unit price.
determinism_notes: Order IDs, line IDs, category names, status values, quantities, prices, grouping dimensions, rollup labels, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE revenue_orders (order_id INT PRIMARY KEY, order_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE revenue_lines (line_id INT PRIMARY KEY, order_id INT NOT NULL, product_id INT NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL, unit_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE revenue_products (product_id INT PRIMARY KEY, category_id INT NOT NULL, product_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE revenue_categories (category_id INT PRIMARY KEY, category_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.category_name IS NULL THEN '(all categories)' ELSE c.category_name END AS category_label, CASE WHEN o.order_status IS NULL THEN '(all statuses)' ELSE o.order_status END AS status_label, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(rl.quantity * rl.unit_price), 2) AS revenue_total FROM revenue_orders AS o JOIN revenue_lines AS rl ON rl.order_id = o.order_id JOIN revenue_products AS p ON p.product_id = rl.product_id JOIN revenue_categories AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name, o.order_status WITH ROLLUP
